title: An integer-valued density on an oriented rectifiable set gives an IMRep
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ and U ⊆ ℝ^P open. Let N ⊆ U be Borel and countably n-rectifiable with Hⁿ(N ∩ K) < ∞ for every compact K ⊆ U. Let η : ℝ^P → Λ_n(ℝ^P) (MultiVector P n) be strongly measurable. Let m : ℝ^P → ℝ be measurable with m(x) ∈ ℤ for every x and ∫_{N∩K} |m| dHⁿ < ∞ for every compact K ⊆ U. Assume that for Hⁿ-a.e. x ∈ N there is a linear subspace Q with HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n N x Q and IsUnitOrientationOf (η(x)) Q. Then there is an IMRep R in U such that R.action(ω) = ∫_N m(x)·η(x)(ω(x)) dHⁿ(x) for every n-form ω : ℝ^P → Λⁿ(ℝ^P) (DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n, no regularity required).
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U N : Set (Euclid P)) (η : Euclid P → MultiVector P n) (m : Euclid P → ℝ), IsOpen U → MeasurableSet N → N ⊆ U → CountablyRectifiable n N → (∀ K : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → μHE[n] (N ∩ K) ≠ ∞) → StronglyMeasurable η → Measurable m → (∀ x, ∃ z : ℤ, m x = z) → (∀ K : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → ∫⁻ x in N ∩ K, ‖m x‖ₑ ∂μHE[n] ≠ ∞) → (∀ᵐ x ∂(μHE[n].restrict N), ∃ Q : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P), HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n N x Q ∧ IsUnitOrientationOf (η x) Q) → ∃ R : IMRep U n, ∀ ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n, R.action ω = ∫ x in N, m x * η x (ω x) ∂μHE[n]
